en: The postcard shows an old, hand-colored street scene dominated by late 19th or early 20th-century buildings in a European architectural style. There are tree-lined avenues, specifically identified as 'Esplanaden,' and the printed and written text on the front is in Swedish. The reverse side includes more Swedish text, an address in Norrköping, and a green Swedish stamp postmarked in 1905.
